# Huang's Blog

> Personal blog of Huang Lizhuo — projects and notes on things he builds and learns. Bilingual: English (default, unprefixed URLs) and Chinese (under /zh/).

Author: Huang Lizhuo
- GitHub: https://github.com/huanglizhuo
- X: https://x.com/huang4fun

## Pages

- [Home](https://blog.clothpath.com/): About the author and featured projects
- [Posts](https://blog.clothpath.com/posts/): All blog posts (English)
- [About](https://blog.clothpath.com/about/): About the author and his projects
- [首页](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/): 中文版首页
- [文章](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/posts/): 全部文章（中文）
- [关于](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/about/): 关于作者（中文）

## Projects

- [OctoCounts](https://octocounts.com/): Free SLOC counter for public GitHub repositories (web app + browser extension)
- [EchoPod](https://echopod.clothpath.com/): Language learning app built around AI subtitles for podcasts
- [Ketsuin 結印](https://ketsuin.clothpath.com/): Web-based input method using ninja hand signs detected in the browser
- [QwenASR](https://github.com/huanglizhuo/QwenASR): Pure-Rust, CPU-only inference engine for Qwen3-ASR speech-to-text
